title: Robotic Cell Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Robotic Cell Job Safety Analysis template for manufacturing you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Entering Cell-Unexpected robot motion
-Bypassed safety gates		-Crush
-Struck by
-Entanglement		25 (VERY HIGH)-Verify safe mode engaged
-Place controller in teach mode
-Carry teach pendant
-Never bypass safety gates
2. Teaching Positions-Pinch points
-Uncontrolled movement
-Programming errors		-Crush injuries
-Struck by		20 (VERY HIGH)-Use slow speed (≤250mm/s)
-Keep body clear of robot path
-Watch for unexpected moves
-Use deadman switch properly
-Verify all axes limits
3. End Effector Setup-Pinch points
-Sharp tools
-Compressed air
-Electrical hazards		-Hand/finger injuries
-Cuts
-Pneumatic injection		16 (HIGH)-LOTO for tool changes
-Handle sharp tools with care
-Verify gripper pressure
-Check all connections
-Inspect cables/hoses
4. Dry Run & Testing-Program bugs
-Unexpected paths
-Workpiece interference		-Collision
-Tool damage
-Part ejection		12 (HIGH)-Run at reduced speed
-Watch for interference
-Verify safety zones
-Test emergency stops
-Check for pinch points
5. Production Operation-Auto mode startup
-Part ejection
-Safeguard failure		-Crush
-Struck by
-Eye injury		15 (HIGH)-Verify all guards in place
-Test light curtains
-Check perimeter fencing
-Never enter cell in auto mode
-Monitor from safe zone

REQUIRED PPE: ☐ Hard Hat ☐ Safety Glasses ☐ Face Shield ☐ Hearing Protection ☐ Steel-Toe Boots ☐ Gloves

☐ Arc Flash PPE (if electrical work)
